description: This file defines the RestXmlSerializer class, which extends the RestSerializer class to handle serialization of REST API requests with XML payloads for AWS SDK. It includes methods for constructing the XML body and setting appropriate headers.

classes.name: RestXmlSerializer
classes.description: A serializer class for handling XML payloads in AWS REST API requests; extends RestSerializer and provides methods to generate XML bodies with specific character replacements.

methods.name: __construct
methods.description: Constructs a RestXmlSerializer with provided API service description, endpoint, and optional XML body formatter.

methods.name: payload
methods.description: Prepares the request payload by setting the Content-Type header to 'application/xml' and generating the XML body from the given structure shape and value.

methods.name: getXmlBody
methods.description: Generates the XML string for the body, performing character replacements for quotes, carriage returns, and newlines.
